visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a modern, square stainless steel pan on a gas stove burner. Inside, large chunks of green loofah (sponge gourd) and several grey-shelled clams are simmering in a bubbling liquid. A metal spatula is used by a person's hand to gently stir the contents. The lighting is bright and clear, highlighting the steam rising from the pan. (2) The scene shifts to an empty, clean square pan on the stove. Tiny droplets of water are seen skittering across the hot metal surface, demonstrating that the pan has reached a high temperature. The background shows a white-tiled kitchen wall. The lighting is natural and highlights the reflective quality of the stainless steel. (3) A woman's hand enters the frame from the top, pouring clear oil from a yellow plastic bottle into the center of the pan. Shortly after, she adds a couple of cloves of smashed white garlic which begin to sizzle. The setting is a domestic kitchen with standard home appliances visible in the background. (4) A pile of freshly chopped loofah pieces, with bright green skin and white interior flesh, is slid into the hot pan from a grey cutting board. The woman, shown from the chest up, has long reddish-brown hair and wears a grey t-shirt with a cartoon cat graphic. She uses a metal spatula to toss the loofah. (5) Clear water is poured from a small, branded stainless steel camping cup into the pan with the loofah. The woman then places a matching stainless steel lid onto the pan. The kitchen environment remains consistent, appearing clean and well-lit. No text is visible on the character's face as she focuses on the task. (6) The woman removes the lid to show the loofah pieces are softening and changing color. She uses a small white measuring spoon to sprinkle a white seasoning powder over the vegetables. The camera maintains a medium shot, focusing on her hands and the pan. Lighting remains bright and even across the workspace. (7) A large batch of fresh, closed clams is poured from another shallow pan into the pan with the steamed loofah. The clams have various patterns of grey, brown, and white. The loofah has released more juice, creating a light green broth. The woman continues to stir the mixture carefully. (8) After putting the lid back on for a few moments, she removes it to reveal that all the clams have opened wide. The steam is dense, and the dish appears ready. The camera zooms in slightly to capture the vibrant green of the loofah and the cooked clams in the broth. (9) The woman carries the entire square pan from the kitchen to a wooden dining table in a separate room. She sits down, picks up a large metal spoon, and blows on a piece of loofah before eating it. She looks directly into the camera with a satisfied expression and gives a thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, cheerful acoustic guitar track in a major key. Superimposed over this BGM is the distinct sound of sizzling as water droplets hit a hot metal pan, creating short, sharp spectral bursts of high-frequency noise. There are no spoken vocals throughout. (2) As the video progresses, the guitar music continues its steady rhythm. New sound effects emerge, including the percussive 'clack' of garlic hitting the pan and a prolonged, broadband sizzling noise as oil and vegetables interact. The spectral weight is balanced between the melodic music and the bright cooking sounds. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound is heard as water is added, followed by the heavy metallic 'clank' of a lid being placed on a pan. The environmental noise floor remains very low, suggesting a quiet indoor recording. The BGM remains the dominant tonal element, providing a consistent emotional energy. (4) The sound of the lid being lifted creates another metallic scrape and ring. This is followed by the sharp, multi-layered percussive clattering of numerous clam shells being poured into the pan. Each individual shell impact is audible, creating a dense acoustic texture. (5) Final audio events include the soft thud of the pan being placed on a wooden table and the metallic scrape of a spoon against the pan's surface. A faint 'huff' of air is audible as the character blows on the food. The guitar music continues smoothly until the end of the clip.
